content.comment_body: I've just acquired my first [product_name] and I'm unable to get the [product_name] display panel to communicate with it. I've attached two screenshots that may clarify the issue. I've tried various cables and all settings shown in the screenshot, but nothing works. Any suggestions are welcome.
What is the IP address of the [product_name]? Are [product_name] and the display device connected directly or via a router?

Thank you for responding. The devices are directly connected by a cable. I can't determine the IP address of the [product_name], but it should be one of the three addresses shown in the screenshot. I've tried each one, but none work. I believe the issue may be related to the IP configuration.

Do you have a [product_name] without a display? The default IP addresses for [product_name] and its display panel with firmware [version_no] are: [product_name]: 192.168.0.3, display panel: 192.168.0.2, both with subnet mask 255.255.255.0. If [company_name] has not changed this for newer models, it should work. When devices are directly connected, no gateway address is required.
Thank you, that was very helpful. The issue is now resolved.
Hello [user_name], glad to hear that. Is your issue solved now?
A new question posted by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread titled 'Not able to communicate with [product_name] v8 and [product_name] display panel.' Best regards [user_name]

The issue stemmed from network setup rather than hardware or software malfunction. Advice on default IP addresses and connection methods enabled users to resolve the problem.
